Budget (user-directed headroom for complex levels): 10M macro steps ~= 94M native ticks ~= 5-10x the user historical per-level budget of 10-20M native-tick steps.

lineage.collapse_summary: run 1 (macro-ppo-5090, s99081680) collapsed into the never-fire attractor: two consecutive macro-native 12-panel checkpoints fired below the 73-shot transplant-init baseline (94 then 10 shots), so it was stopped early and reported FAIL
lineage.pivot_summary: run 2 (macro-ppo-5090-r2, s99081682) was stopped at ~13% budget by a user-directed strategy pivot, not a tier-0 breach: 6M macro steps over 49 levels gives ~122k macro steps (~1.1M native ticks) per level versus the user historical single-level budget of 10-20M native-tick steps. The anti-collapse knobs were verified healthy before the stop (checkpoints 786k/1573k fired 304/280 shots vs the 73-shot baseline, on-target 1.00), so this specialist run reuses them unchanged.

trainer.note: v2 owns validation, PPO construction, the learn loop, receipts, and checkpointing; the v2b delegate below only rebinds the env factories (stack UNDER macro) and injects --init-model

delegate.stack_position_rationale: the ring buffer advances every NATIVE tick a macro consumes, so the policy sees true frame(t-4)/frame(t-8) context at each macro decision point, identical to the distill-v3 training layout and the probe-v5 runtime convention

initial_model.lineage: BC frame-stack final s99081671 (self-driven aim p50 20 bins, recovery 9/12) -> macro transplant s99081679: feature extractor and aim head verbatim, macro verb head from per-tick rows [wait,fire,swap] (hop dropped), value pathway fresh
initial_model.interface: macro MultiDiscrete([3, 180]) over stacked Box(3 x 22904)
initial_model.note: also injected at launch via v2b --init-model; the CLI injection and this block must agree at freeze

trainer_v2.discounting_note: gamma applies PER MACRO STEP; the macro reward is the undiscounted per-tick sum over the ticks the macro consumed (~20-70), so 0.999 per macro is roughly 0.999^(1/40) per native tick; truncation is reward-neutral (v2 wrapper), so 24000-tick late-level truncations bootstrap instead of paying -10

levels_scope.rule: SINGLE-LEVEL specialist campaign: this preregistration trains exactly one level, Jungle2, per the user-directed per-level pivot recorded in the run-2 outcome (sha256:1133eaae654726c5e47ce01e0428a01e593ac2c84702403012f02073d909de11)
levels_scope.pivot_note: the run-2 dual-position machinery (the INCLUDED_LEVELS minus DUAL_POSITION_LEVELS rule and its 6 exclusions) is retired for this document because only Jungle2 is in scope; Jungle2 is macro-reachable (teacher win through the macro interface, 55-level teacher ceiling map teacher55 (s99081681)) and its catalog entry is carried verbatim from the frozen run-2 document

environment.reward_note: score_progress_reward_cap is owned by trainer_v2 (10.0); time-limit truncation pays NO terminal penalty (v2 TruncationNeutralRewardWrapper), per the verified root-cause fixes

runs.description: single-level speedrun specialist: ~10h macro-interface PPO fine-tune from the transplanted BC init on Jungle2 only (cuda:1); num_envs 40 targets ~80% utilization of the 48 WSL cores across the two concurrent specialist runs (80 workers total, oversubscription amortized by the synchronous inference gaps)
runs.checkpoint_note: one macro step is one policy timestep (~20-70 native ticks); 1048576 steps is roughly every 50-60 minutes at projected throughput and gives 9 interior checkpoints over the 10M budget; NOTE both specialist runs (cuda:0 and cuda:1) share the same CPU, so per-run throughput may drop ~25% versus a solo run; if observed throughput is far off, adjust checkpoint_every at freeze, never mid-run
runs.budget_note: total_steps 10M is the budget (user-directed headroom for complex levels): 10M macro steps ~= 94M native ticks ~= 5-10x the user historical per-level budget of 10-20M native-tick steps; the schedule's training_stop_utc is the wall-clock backstop and the v2 callback stops there

evaluation_cadence.panel: single trained level: Jungle2 (the probe-v4 12-level panel is retired for this single-level document)
evaluation_cadence.when: per checkpoint (roughly every 50-60 minutes), student_only, deterministic masked predict; eval device chosen at eval time so as not to preempt the concurrent specialist trainings on cuda:0/cuda:1
evaluation_cadence.best_checkpoint_eval: the best checkpoint by per-checkpoint Jungle2 results gets an 8-seed Jungle2 eval (seeds 1400920000..1400920007); tier_2 and tier_3 are judged on that 8-seed eval

instrument.interface: macro-native: direct MultiDiscrete([3, 180]) macro masks (no per-tick 4+180 adaptation), ObservationStackWrapper(0,4,8) UNDER the macro in the env factory, same telemetry and receipts as macro-eval-v1

evaluation_cadence.telemetry: same outcome/shot telemetry as macro-eval-v1: wins, winning ticks (median over wins), shots, shots_on_target_rate (wrapper fidelity, expect ~1.0), macro fire rate vs teacher's, mask_fallbacks; score is recorded only as a liveness diagnostic, never as a success metric

success_criteria_tiers.scope_note: all tiers are STUDENT_ONLY autonomous outcomes on engineering-seed evals of Jungle2; teacher-assisted or recovery-mode wins count for nothing here. SPEEDRUN objective: success is win rate first, then median winning ticks; SCORE IS EXPLICITLY NOT A SUCCESS METRIC at any tier (it appears in telemetry only as a liveness diagnostic)
success_criteria_tiers.tier_0_sanity: wrapper fidelity holds under the trained policy: shots_on_target_rate >= 0.95 on every eval, and the policy fires at >= 0.5x the teacher's macro fire rate (the BC init fires ~20x too rarely; PPO must at least not collapse further)
success_criteria_tiers.tier_1_signal: any autonomous Jungle2 win at any checkpoint
success_criteria_tiers.tier_2_promising: win rate >= 50% over the 8-seed Jungle2 eval of the best checkpoint
success_criteria_tiers.tier_3_strong: median winning ticks over the 8-seed eval of the best checkpoint <= 1.5x the teacher-through-macro Jungle2 time: 55-level teacher ceiling map teacher55 (s99081681) won Jungle2 in 2300 native ticks (completion sha256:a35dd7e1cd182b0d59ce69a6ef4d91f6310511735d0da5d5b9d7e068b24f9d20), so the threshold is 3450 ticks

teacher_reference.threshold_rule: tier_3 threshold = floor(1.5 x teacher ticks)

success_criteria_tiers.failure_is_reportable: if tier 1 is not reached, the run is reported as FAIL with the full eval telemetry; no re-slicing after the fact

seed_isolation.training_range_rule: episode_seed_base 1474000000 + 40 workers x stride 100000 = [1474000000, 1477999999], moved up from 1469000000 to stay disjoint from the Jungle1 specialist's widened 40-worker range [1466000000, 1469999999]; still far below the embargoed formal floor 1600000000 and disjoint from every prior training range (run 2 ended at 1465399999)
